activity_summary: At home you put the queen at a hedge and left her there. The gardener is not yet a man with a name. You did not write a parliament, and you did not finish the day.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Added a few lines at the foot of Sunday's sheet and did not finish them.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Still at the hedge

facets.activity: Wrote the queen as far as the hedge
